home.title: Home
home.subtitle: Today's intention starts here.
home.body: Choose a small intention and return to it through the day.

manifest.title: Manifest
manifest.subtitle: Name the intention, then make room for it.
manifest.step1: Write the intention in one sentence.
manifest.step2: Say it in the present tense.
manifest.step3: Read it once more at the end of the day.

vision.title: Vision Board
vision.subtitle: Bring the life you want to see into one place.

affirmations.title: Affirmations
affirmations.subtitle: The sentences you tell yourself carry the day.
affirmations.line1: I gently make room for myself.
affirmations.line2: I build the life I want with calm steps.
affirmations.line3: Today is a good enough beginning.

angelNumbers.title: Angel Numbers
angelNumbers.subtitle: Look at the meaning of the numbers that find you.
angelNumbers.n111: A new beginning — stay with your intention.
angelNumbers.n222: Balance, patience, and trust on the path.
angelNumbers.n333: Guidance is near; your creation is supported.
angelNumbers.n444: You are protected; your steps have solid ground.
angelNumbers.n555: Change is close; stay open to the flow.
angelNumbers.n777: Spiritual awakening, luck, and stronger intuition.

common.confirm: Are you sure you want to continue?
